start.title: Out of Egypt
start.text:
Israel walks free at first light.
Which way will you lead them?

choices.text: Take the short road by the sea
Follow the Lord's pillar of cloud
Hurry back to beg Pharaoh's blessing

short_road_consequence.title: Not That Way
short_road_consequence.text:
The Philistines guard that path.
The Lord leads another way.

choices.text: Follow the Lord's pillar of cloud

beg_consequence.title: Do Not Turn Back
beg_consequence.text:
Egypt is behind you forever.
Look only ahead.

choices.text: Follow the Lord's pillar of cloud
choices.feedback: You set your face to the desert.

pillar_follows.title: Pillar of Cloud
pillar_follows.text:
By day a cloud, by night a fire.
The Lord goes before His people.

choices.text: Press on as He leads you

pharaoh_regrets.title: Pharaoh's Regret
pharaoh_regrets.text:
In Egypt the king curses his weakness.
"Bring back our slaves!"

choices.text: Speed back to plead with him
Trust the Lord and keep moving
Hide the people in the dunes
choices.feedback: There is no hiding from this.

plead_consequence.title: No More Pleading
plead_consequence.text:
His chariots are already rolling.
The time for words is gone.

choices.text: Trust the Lord and keep moving

hide_consequence.title: Sand Cannot Hide You
hide_consequence.text:
Six hundred chariots can find you.
Only the Lord can save you.

choices.text: Trust the Lord and keep moving

army_charges.title: Dust on the Horizon
army_charges.text:
A red cloud rises behind you.
Chariots. Hundreds of them.

choices.text: Tell the people: do not fear
Run with them toward the cliffs

run_consequence.title: Stand Firm
run_consequence.text:
There is nowhere left to run.
The Lord will fight for you.

choices.text: Tell the people: do not fear

people_panic.title: "Why Bring Us Here to Die?"
people_panic.text:
The people cry out, trembling.
"Were there no graves in Egypt?"

choices.text: Curse them for their unbelief
Surrender the people to Pharaoh
Speak peace: stand and see Him

curse_consequence.title: Speak Hope, Not Wrath
curse_consequence.text:
They are afraid. So were you once.
Lead them with His promise.

choices.text: Speak peace: stand and see Him

surrender_consequence.title: Never Back to Chains
surrender_consequence.text:
He did not free you to bind you.
Stand and trust His hand.

choices.text: Speak peace: stand and see Him

moses_prays.title: A Cry to Heaven
moses_prays.text:
You stand at the water's edge.
Only the Lord can open this.

choices.text: Demand the people build boats
Lift your staff over the sea
Wait silently for some other sign

boats_consequence.title: No Boats Tonight
boats_consequence.text:
He needs no wood, no sails.
His breath is enough.

choices.text: Lift your staff over the sea

wait_consequence.title: He Has Spoken
wait_consequence.text:
"Why do you cry to me? Go forward."
The sign is in your hand.

choices.text: Lift your staff over the sea

sea_parts.title: The Waters Divide
sea_parts.text:
A great wind splits the sea in two.
A dry road opens through it.

choices.text: Send the people across at once
Stand back and only watch
choices.feedback: It opened so you could go.

watch_consequence.title: Walk Through It
watch_consequence.text:
His miracle is for crossing.
Lead them between the walls.

choices.text: Send the people across at once
choices.feedback: You step onto the dry seabed.

crossing.title: Between the Walls
crossing.text:
Walls of water rise on each side.
Israel walks the dry path.

choices.text: Boast of your power before them
choices.feedback: It is His arm, not yours.

choices.text: Lead them toward the far shore

boast_consequence.title: His Hand, Not Yours
boast_consequence.text:
Give Him glory, not yourself.
Lead with a humble heart.

choices.text: Lead them toward the far shore
choices.feedback: You bow your head and walk.

far_shore.title: On the Far Shore
far_shore.text:
Israel stands safe. Behind you,
chariots crash into the corridor.

choices.text: Mock the drowning soldiers
choices.feedback: Do not laugh at His judgment.

choices.text: Run back to fight them yourself
Stretch your hand back over the sea
choices.feedback: The wind shifts at your hand.

mock_consequence.title: Solemn, Not Proud
mock_consequence.text:
His judgment is heavy and just.
Receive it with awe.

choices.text: Stretch your hand back over the sea

fight_consequence.title: He Fights for You
fight_consequence.text:
Do not lift a sword tonight.
Lift only your hand at His word.

choices.text: Stretch your hand back over the sea

sea_closes.title: The Sea Returns
sea_closes.text:
The walls fall as one great wave.
Not one chariot rises again.

choices.text: Sing to the Lord with the people

ending.title: Saved by His Hand
ending.text:
Israel stands free on the shore.
The Lord alone has saved them.
